name: FigureQA
intro: FigureQA是一个合成科学图表视觉推理数据集。它先在约束下采样数值数据，再用改造后的Bokeh渲染五类图表并抽取元素边界框，随后从15个模板生成Yes/No问题并平衡答案；训练集含10万图和130万问题，验证集与测试集各含2万图和超过25万问题。
org: Microsoft Research Montréal, Université de Montréal/MILA, Tilburg University
build_method: 受约束数值采样, 改造Bokeh合成渲染, 15类模板问答生成, Yes/No平衡, 交替配色划分
modality: 图像, 文本, 数值源数据, 边界框
task_type: 合成图表视觉问答, 关系推理
eval_feature: 5类图表, 15类二元模板, 100种X11颜色, 未见颜色-图表组合
scale: 训练10万图/130万问题；验证与测试各2万图/超过25万问题
modality_en: Image, Text, Numerical Source Data, Bounding Boxes
task_type_en: Synthetic Chart Visual QA, Relational Reasoning
build_method_en: Constrained Numerical Sampling, Modified-Bokeh Synthetic Rendering, 15-template QA Generation, Yes/No Balancing, Alternated-color Splits
eval_feature_en: 5 Plot Types, 15 Binary Templates, 100 X11 Colors, Unseen Color-plot Combinations
intro_en: FigureQA is a synthetic scientific-chart visual-reasoning dataset. It samples constrained numerical data, renders five plot types with a modified Bokeh stack while extracting element boxes, then generates balanced Yes/No questions from 15 templates. The training set has 100k images and 1.3M questions; validation and test each have 20k images and more than 250k questions.
scale_en: Train 100k images / 1.3M questions; validation and test 20k images / >250k questions each

drawio_review_note: Paper-aligned against arXiv:1710.07300v2 Sections 3.1-3.3, Tables 1-2, and Appendix C, then code-audited against Maluuba/FigureQA commit 1981b72f7ca48526fd8ca594b3713407d2857e4f. The official generation config SHA-256 is a853b4f02f5ae3a1d800e7987de88480dde6f3a02d87f9b843ed8477592e46a2; the 100-color resource is 63079d170f00787d65ec0516d83390d85fb5ab8f154965128f9ca14005fc3343 and its two 50-color splits are 930593c67615de12dbd68d74ba3014e848c76e6667f80cf6165482a789737fc9 and c3b2b42ee40b98213b94a89969d187f89ea21d29ae29e48b1df6e20cb47d15a8. Before a split is generated, the config selects a color_scheme YAML and maps every plot type to one of the disjoint 50-color halves; this mapping constrains the subsequent numerical sampling, question generation, and modified-Bokeh rendering. Modified Bokeh emits RGB PNGs plus source data and element bounding boxes. Fifteen question IDs generate binary relations. The code balances Yes/No counts by question ID across a split by dropping surplus answers while preserving at least one question per figure. The paper release contains train 100k images/1.3M questions and validation/test 20k images/>250k questions each, with 50/50 color halves swapped for alternated validation/test. Release boundary (an evidence-linked audit branch, not an output of the accuracy metric): the pinned figureqa_generation_config.yaml only names train1, val1, and val2, and the official README explicitly says that config does not generate the test sets. The linked public archive is unversioned; no immutable dataset checksum is published. The generator repository defines no canonical model prompt or answer parser and no model-generation settings; the paper task is exact Yes/No prediction reported as overall and per-template accuracy.
